balls.text: gets the yorker right, fields cleanly in his follow through, the batsmen have to go for the one, and he runs Chawla out easily
that's a beamer, slipped out of his hand, Chawla sways out of the way easily, McLaren looks at his hand and then apologises. Meanwhile it bounces awkwardly in front of Rayudu and goes for byes
and Shalabh does well again, backing up too far and turns this single to long-off into two
and he nicely steers it down to third man to hand over the strike to his UP team-mate
this is better bowling, McLaren bowls a yorker on off, can't get it past extra cover, and he lets No. 11 take strike
lovely strike from Chawla, makes room, gives him all stumps to aim at, gets a length delivery, gets under it and plays it with open face deliberately, over short third man
hits a length ball powerfully down the ground, Bravo runs to his right from long-off, gets a hand onto it while diving, but slips when coming back up and it rolls along for four
timber! You don't need no fielders for this, Malik clears his front leg, Zak is full and straight and in the block hole. Bye bye middle stump

Dhawan should have fielded this! Malik gets a low full toss over point, there isn't much power onto it, Dhawan running from sweeper-cover gets there, but doesn't bend properly and lets it slip under his hand
looks to loft a length ball over leg side, gets an inside edge onto the pad
bouncer, gets Malik in the ribs, Chawla wants a run, Tendulkar misses a direct hit that would have caught Malik miles short
full toss, driven powerfully to long-off for one
what silence in the ground! Chawla has crashed a low full toss past point for four, and it doesn't draw as much as a gentle applause
another slower ball down the leg side, this time Chawla gets bat on it, gets a single to fine leg
slower yorker, way down the leg side again
goes for the bouncer, mis-directs it, for a wide down the leg side
full, straight, fast, Chawla has done well to get his bat down in time - forget about scoring off it
on the pads, and worked away for a single
and nearly another wicket, big lbw shout, as he beats him with a length delivery, but Malik has just about shuffled outside the line of off
one ball too late, but he rattles the timber, another yorker, slower this time, 134ks, and too good for Goel
and he nearly got it! Lovely yorker again, 142ks, pitches between crease and stumps, and moves away to miss the off stump by one of his curls' width
Bhajji is superb again, diving at third man, Chawla runs it fine past the keeper, and Bhajji charges from third man and dives full length to save two runs
square-drives a length ball, Pollard slips and fumbles at deep point, and concedes the second

Lee has holed out to deep midwicket, and he has picked one of the tallest cricketers going around, Pollard - Tendulkar is in splits, maybe because a full toss has resulted in a wicket, but it's just a good sight, watching SRT laughing heartily
goes for the shorter delivery, gets it horribly wrong, way down the leg side
limply hit to mid-on, Sathish hits direct but Lee is in, and they get an overthrow too
low full toss, worked away to deep square leg for one
tucks him up with one aimed for the ribs, gets a bottom edge for one
Malinga you beauty! Perfect yorker! 140ks, Marsh tries to play it with an open face and has his off stump uprooted. Can't play those, I am afraid. He will be on a hat-trick in the next over

amazing catch by Bhajji! undoes all his earlier fumbles! Irfan gets too much underneath this one, and Bhajji has to run backwards from midwicket to get under it, and even though he hasn't got himself into great position he holds onto it and tumbles over. Gets up and points to Jonty Rhodes
nicely played, Malinga missed his yorker length only by inches and he was ready to get under it and loft it over extra cover
full and straight again, manages to dig it out and gets a single
full and fast again, hits it to point and comes through for one... Tiwary fumbles, else it could have been interesting
low and fast full toss, no timing on it, and hit to SRT at cover
flighted on off, driven down to long-off for one
flat, on the pads, worked away between deep square leg and deep midwicket for two
hit straight to short fine leg and they come through for a single - Bhaj not impressed with Zak
full, outside off, pushed down to long-off
Marsh steps down too, gets too close to it, and hits it down to long-on, along the ground
comes down the track, is not to the pitch of the ball, but manges to swipe it across the line for a single
I am not gonna call them slower balls, he is bowling offcutters only, and Irfan - like me - is expecting it and pushes a length delivery into the covers
pushed down to long-off for one
welcome back Shaun, fifty in first innings back! again Bravo bowls a slower ball too many, this time he waits a bit more and cuts it past cover-point
slower ball again, looks to cut this from in front of the stumps, hits it one bounce to cover-point
slower ball outside off, looks to guide it past short third but finds Malinga
loose bowling , down the leg side, and Marsh will keep punishing those, nicely glanced away fine of a square fine leg
full on the pads, worked away for a single
lovely bowling, this is nicely flighted, 84ks, dips on him, drawing him out of the crease, manages to get bat on it after getting beaten in the flight
93ks yorker, beats Marsh
pushed down to long-off for a single
worked away square of fine leg and they come back for two
full delivery, gets a leading edge as Irfan looks to turn it to leg, and it falls between the two points and some misunderstanding between Bravo and Pollard results in two
an even slower delivery, Irfan bunts it into the covers for one
short on the pads, slower ball again, Marsh waits on it unlike Yuvraj and pulls it for a single
lovely offcutter, Marsh is looking leg side, and gets a thick edge - one bounce to point
drives a length ball down to long-off for one

one of the softest dismissals you'll see! slower ball on the pads, Yuvraj is so early into the shot it hits the back of the pad and lobs to Bhajji at short fine, who has an I-told-you look on his face as he goes on a celebratory run
slower ball on the pads, worked away to deep midwicket
quicker delivery now, catches Yuvi at back foot, takes a thick edge past slip
nicely flighted, Yuvi is pushing at it, could have been a return catch had it dipped a bit more

both of them have been run out! Poor running again! Mahela makes room and hits it square, Malinga fumbles, Mahela comes back for two. By the half way mark, Marsh knows it's a bad call, and stops there and watches Mahela get run out. Just to make sure they get a wicket from this delivery, they run down the stumps at non-striker's end too
full, on the pads, pushed to deep midwicket
makes room and cuts a fullish delivery to deep point
pitched outside leg, breaking towards the stumps, worked away for a single
slower ball, too full, and driven to sweeper-cover for one
full and fast, clears the front leg, and mis-hits it down to long-off
Mahela still struggling, rapid bouncer, 143ks, there is nowhere to go as this aimed at his throat, Mahela's bat comes in slow motion as he looks to hook, and the top edge clears the keeper
goes for the quick yorker, gives him enough room to open the face and get it to third man
slower ball, and he mis-hits past midwicket, and another poor throw from Tiwary - half way down the pitch - lets them come back for two
starts with a straight yorker, hit back to the bowler
on the pads and worked away to fine leg
yorker, not much pace on it, Mahela squeezes it past point for one
quicker delivery this time, but angled way down the leg side
another slower delivery, legcutter this time, starts wide and keeps on going wider
runs this one down to short third for a single
one slower ball too many, Marsh is as if Pollard announced on his Twitter page that he was going to bowl a slower delivery. Waits for it, clears the front leg, and lofts it way over long-on
slower ball, too short, and cut away, Sathish's dive at backward point saves three runs
slower ball, he is early into it and hits it in the air, but wide enough of Pollard
that's more the Mahela we know, gets on top of the bounce, and late-cuts, all along the ground, making sure he pierces the point-short-third gap

under-cuts a delivery that would have been called a wide had he not played at it. That's not all, he comes on for a poorly-judged second, and Tiwary the fielder hangs on to the ball before letting go a weak throw. Ordinary cricket all around
on the pads, nudged away for one
pushed to mid-on, and comes through for a risky single, Sathish's throw misses
they came down the pitch, shook hands and went back - such was the misunderstanding - Pollard hadn't collected cleanly at point, else it was curtains for Mahela
Bhajji fields cleanly this time at extra cover and goes for the throw as Marsh is sent back. There is a bad bounce, but Tendulkar does well backing up
pushes a length ball down the ground for a single
dug in short again, pulled in front of square, to deep midwicket
nurdled to short fine leg
Zaheer at short third does well, despite backward point diving in front of him, and keeps this dab down to one
second fumble for Harbhajan, this time at deep square leg, and this time it costs them the second - SRT is not happy
dabs a short delivery to backward point for a single
overpitched, nicely drive, straight to extra cover
defended with an open face, wide of cover, comes for a single
flighted, and falls short of where Mahela is expecting and ends up whipping it in front of his body, turning his wrists to keep it down
yorked, quick ball too, Bhajji misses a trick by not appealing - it hit pad first
bunted to midwicket for a single
poor keeping again, not to be too harsh on Rayudu because he is not a genuine keeper, pitched outside leg, straightened, and went between Rayudu and Marsh
length ball, defended, not much spin
back of a length, on the stumps, defended
yorker, Marsh bunts it to point and comes through for a quick single
that's the highest I have seen a checked shot go! This slower ball spits at him, and he has to check the drive, and the skier settles in Zaheer Khan's hands at mid-off
just short of being a yorker, and he has dug it out for two, through midwicket
after Tare, Rayudu struggles with the gloves, the slower ball beats Bisla, but Rayudu doesn't get his body behind it and lets through four byes
Bisla is sat on back foot immediately, defends a length delivery
full on the pads, nearly a yorker, digs it out and gets into the gap on the on side
worked away with the angle, past square leg, has hit it well enough to come back for two
angling into the pads, looks to whip it square, is beaten, the ball deflects off the pad into the point region
length ball on the pads, driven to mid-on, Harbhajan fumbles but it doesn't cost them the second
fuller, but not driving length, and there is not much room either
short, and at a gentle pace, and it has been thumped over square leg for four - Bisla won't let these ones go
over-pitched, but Marsh finds extra cover on this drive
superb shot this one, not a bad delivery, just short of a length, and he has on-driven it on the up, between bowler and mid-on
long-hop, doesn't get too high, and Marsh rocks back and deposits it into the square-leg boundary
makes a one-handed save in his follow through, it's hit back well and McLaren has to quickly go down to his left
angled into the pads, worked away for one to fine leg
whipped away off the stumps, past square leG
presses forward and defends a length delivery outside off
Marsh is being made to feel at home. Zak goes for a yorker, but it ends up being a half-volley and he smashes it down the ground. No chance for mid-on
the square fine leg is hurting Mumbai. Marsh misses as he looks to whip it off the leg stump, but the deflection off the pads is healthy enough to reach the boundary
gets a thick outside edge first up, which files past slip, but third man is fine

he is gone, poor shot, plays across the line of a full, straight delivery, and misses. It was bowled from close to the stumps, half of it pitched within the line of leg stump, and was too full to have angled across the off stump
starts on target, not driving length, and around middle and off, played to midwicket
nicely cut away, can't beat backward point
on the pads, and Marsh gets a fine tickle - the fine leg is too square
opens the face on this one, but there isn't much room here to work with
defends a length ball off the front foot
tip-and-run to cover, soft hands, quick call, hard running
hint of swing there, Bopara lets it go untouched wide outside off
fittingly it has finished with a wide down the leg side. Finally Bisla makes a clean take, but the game is over by then. Full marks for that dive and commitment, though
makes room early, the slower bouncer chases him, he pulls and keeps it down, Shalabh is lazy at fine leg, the fumble costs them the extra run
powerfully driven straight down the ground, between long-on and long-off - who should be up in the circle anyway. Bopara makes a diving save and keeps them to two
he has got under it and smashed it to deep square leg for one
well not quite ending! another turn? Tiwary pulls this short delivery, flat and low to deep midwicket where Goel dives forward to keep the game alive
comes down the track and agricultures this length ball for a straight four, it's ending fast here
cut away to sweeper-cover for one
another superb shot, back of a length, on middle and leg, and he makes room and places it past point, no deep point there, lovely placement

Bisla is a Sanga in the making, if only he can bat as gracefully! Just because he collects a yorker cleanly, Bisla belts out a blood-curdling appeal, not quite Sangakkara, though. Doctrove not impressed
what a shot, inside-out over extra, clean strike, and it's Malik who is diving again in vain
clears his front leg and chips a length ball down to long-off
full outside off, driven down to long-off
what power! walks down, is nearly beaten by the bouncer, and he just flat-bats it down the ground, and quite incredibly it carries over long-off
throws everything behind this, gets it over point, comes back for two, and Bisla misses a regulation throw to give away an overthrow
angled across him, and Sathish is jumping down the track first ball and misses
lovely yorker, middle stump, will be just a single

and Bopara comes right back with a vicious slower one! Or so Bravo makes it seem, this is shorter and not in Bravo's striking zone, and as it kicks at him, Bravo is all squared up and fends at it. Bopara runs in to his right and takes a diving catch!
Bravo plays the big shot under pressure, picks the back-of-the-length delivery, charges down and lofts it high and long, clearing long-on
back of a length, muscled down to long-on for one
another slower ball that grips, back-of-the-hand stuff, Bravo is way early into it, the bottom hand comes off, and he gets a single off the mis-hit
punched away to sweeper-cover for one
slower ball, kicks at him, steered to short third for one
another yorker, straight this time, hit back to the bowler, who slides across the pitch and gets his foot in the way. Bravo sends Tiwary back
poor umpiring! yorker outside off, at least six inches inside the line, called a wide
ugly slog from wide outside off, gets a top edge and Yuvraj takes a simple catch at point. This game is not over
tries the same delivery but this is pushed too far across
smartly bowled, sees him come down and slips in a full, wide delivery
has to be a beamer! Tiwary gets bat on it but how does he get away with this one? Definitely a high full toss
comes down the track to sower delivery and gets a single to long-off
full toss on the pads, lucky for Shalabh as he gets just a single off it
long hop, and Rayudu tucks into it, and murders it wide of long-on, where poor Malik puts in a desperate dive
short delivery, hurries onto him, he will get just a single to long-off

he has slog-swept this for a huge six, and Shaun Marsh has back-pedalled himself into the boundary board! Funny how he didn't realise it when he crossed the boundary rope! First boundary in 32 deliveries
stays back and works this to short fine for one
on the pads, worked away for one
slider, Tiwary stays back and pushes, but can't beat mid-off
yorker, guided away to point for one, another good over for Punjab
slower ball, no room, defended back to him
steps down the track, gets a bottom edge on it but will take a single
length ball, driven down the ground for a single
short, pulled away down the ground, long-on is wide, keeps them to one
angled into the pads, worked away for a single
slower bouncer, and it beats Rayudu who is dancing down the wicket
nobody can not call this wides! It's just way too wide down the leg side and Bisla has no chance here
sharp bouncer, goes down the leg side, bowler and keeper appeal just to avoid a wide, and Doctrove obliges
length ball, driven to wide of long-off, but Bopara is alert
short, not much pace behind this, and pulled away easily for one
slower ball again, and Mahela makes another diving save at extra cover, he wants this one bad
slower one outside off, bunted square for a single
nice diving save to his right by Mahela at extra cover as Rayudu drives this slower one from Bopara
short and wide, cut away fine, and Malik has to do the running again at third man
back-of-the-hand slower ball, Dhawan goes for the big shot down the ground, toe-ends it, and Marsh runs in from long-off to complete the catch. Is this the turnaround?
Bisla has got good training from Sanga it seems, as he refuses to stop appealing for lbw on a ball that is clearly angling across the off stump. Fun comes when his bowler is not interested at all
and he has swept away a right-arm medium bowler, in the gap square on the on side, comes back for two to bring up his fifty!
Tiwary sends Dhawan back as he has hit a little too strongly to point
short and wide, cut away for one
powerfully swept away from wide outside off, all along the ground, and Malik is having to run again, keeps them down to two
short and wide again, and cut away to sweeper-cover again
short and wide, cut away to sweeper-cover
swept away square, and a fumble from Malik at deep square lets them come back for two

Pollard has mis-hit and found Bopara at wide long-on, gets power into it but can't get under it and hence no elevation. Bopara runs to his right from long-on, and is mindful of the rope and finishes a smart catch
another slower ball, guided to deep point for one
slower ball, pulled away, Malik at deep square gets a bad bounce but does well to field it cleanly
full ball, driven down to long-off for a single
nice offcutter, Dhawan drives at in, gets an inside edge that somehow evades the stumps - who says this is a just world?
gets a yorker in, which he converts into a low full toss by stepping down, and takes a single midwicket
and follows it with a nice googly that beats Dhawan, who makes it back in after overbalancing for a brief second
big legbreak again, and a big shout for lbw, but Doctrove rightly reckons it's turning down the leg side
looks to cut a flat delivery, gets a bottom edge and comes through for one
what a beautiful shot, no power here, just a mere flick, with the turn, and over long-off easily
no slip there and it goes for four there, Pollard throws all his might at this, gets a regulation edge past the keeper
big legbreak, pitches leg, back of a length, turns away outside off, Pollard stays back and defends
slower offcutter, Pollard takes the bottom hand off to check the shot, and Mahela lets it through his legs at extra cover
makes room, Irfan goes full and wide, and it's a poor call for wide because it went within that marking line, and it was actually smartly bowled
full and wide, driven away to sweeper-cover
length ball on the pads, misses out but gets a leg-bye
slower ball, Pollard hits it on the bounce to cover
punched away to sweeper-cover, a sweep sound emanates from the bat
slower offcutter, Dhawan waits for it, but the slight cut on it gets the bottom edge - all safe, though
full and straight, driven powerfully with an open face, past a diving point who gets a hand to it to keep them down to one
short, long hop, on the pads, and at his military-medium pace, he is saying, "Please pull me for four." Babu obliges
slower ball, too straight and too full, worked away for one to short fine
short and wide, and he punches it, powerfully, and beats sweeper-cover
short and wide, cut away, gets a single to deep point
punched off the pads, wide of long-on, comes back for an easy couple
flighted on the pads, worked around the corner for one
but it's the quick straight flat delivery, which he works away for one

talk about fairplay! Dhawan tips and runs, and Chawla and Pollard collide and Pollard is tripped over, Bisla goes for the run-out but misses. In between the serious stuff, Sunny G has me chuckling. He says, "Now who is the big guy here? Who should fall? There is no way Pollard should be on the ground."
turn there for PC, Dhawan looks to work it fine, finds square leg
Chawla gets SRT again! Tendulkar tries to take long-on on, and the ball grips at him, and all he manages is a hole-out to Irfan
swept away from in front of stumps, gets a bottom edge onto the pad
smears this one down the leg side, 89ks, too much to do for Bisla, another makeshift keeper
he has literally swept him away, not sure what it says about the pace of the bowler, but he has also managed to keep it down, and has got four runs for it
comes down the track, gets the inside half of the bat on this, and takes a single to mid-on
and he bunts and runs, making it easily because they are all so deep
short, not much width, hence he can't get the placement right on this square punch
pushes a shortish delivery square, can't get it past point
long hop and is pulled away powerfully, wide of deep square, comes back for two
round the stumps, Tendulkar looks to force a length delivery through the off side, doesn't connect well
everybody do an Ayatollah, SRT has moved away across the stumps and flicked this from way outside off past short fine leg - and gets the orange cap too
short and wide, and cut fiercely, but on a half-volley to Bopara at cover-point - well done to get hands to it
swing again, starts outside off, and Babu lets it go
tries the same shot, but not short enough for it, yet gets a leg-bye
back of a length, on the pads, and SRT gets inside the room and lofts it over short fine leg - party is over for Shalabh
another slower ball, played straight to point this time, Babu wants one but SRT sends him back
slower ball, punched away with an angled bat, square of third man, comes back for two
full and wide outside off, left alone for a change
lovely square-drive, there are five fielders on the cover ring, and he gets it between cover and extra cover. Power? Check. Placement? Check
slight shape, punched down to mid-off and they come through for one
back of a length, driven to extra cover, and they take a single
punched to point, where Marsh misfields but they don't take a single. Despite the wide, superb over from Shalabh, just one wide and six dots to SRT
and he has messed it up - he had a good chance to bowl a maiden here, but pitches this back of a length and loses his line, going down the leg side
shape in again, gets a leading edge this time, which is a bit too short and a bit too wide of him
and another dot, angled across, and he looks to work it to on side but gets an inside edge onto the pads
this one is shorter and doesn't swing, Tendulkar is beaten again as he looks to flick, but this is going over the stumps
swing again, beats him again, Shalabh used to be a good inswing bowler for UP before injuries halted his career he lost his swing too
swing first ball, big inswing, big shout too, but umpire Tarapore says going down, and it is going down
quick delivery, tailing in, Tendulkar flicks it with soft hands, gets a single just wide of square leg
slower ball, he stands as is and steers it to third man
that's what many Ranji bowlers have faced for years, a Dhawan square-drive, flashy and clean, past short cover
lovely short-arm pull, the bouncer has hurried him, but he pulls nicely while rocking back, in front of square, past midwicket
back of a length, Babu looks to drop and run, SRT refuses the single, rightly so
starts with a length delivery, driven nicely to cover
